scope: credential-presence and execution-boundary preflight for owner-selected Alibaba Cloud OSS Beijing Object Lock retention

decision.accountPreference: reuse an existing Alibaba Cloud account identity

credentialGap.required: A non-secret reference to an existing Alibaba Cloud RAM identity usable from the execution environment, with narrowly scoped permission to create and inspect one Beijing OSS bucket, configure and inspect 30-day Object Lock/WORM, and put/get/delete only the synthetic validation objects needed for the deny-delete and isolated-readback checks.
acceptableDelivery: Attach an appropriate RAM role to the registered Beijing host and identify the role without sharing temporary keys.
Provision a restricted credential through an existing secret manager and provide only its reference and loading procedure; do not paste AccessKey material into chat or repository files.

plannedValidation: Confirm the resolved account and Beijing endpoint with a safe identity/bucket preflight and estimate every independently billable action below CNY 100.
Create one uniquely named private Beijing bucket using synthetic validation data only.
Configure compliance-mode Object Lock/WORM for 30 days and read back the effective policy.
Upload a small deterministic synthetic object and record only non-sensitive hashes and bounded metadata.
Attempt deletion and require a policy denial while retention is active; do not weaken, shorten, or remove retention.
Read back into a fresh isolated local restore path and verify byte length and SHA-256.
Leave the locked synthetic object governed by its retention policy and record lifecycle/cost exposure; do not attempt destructive cleanup that conflicts with compliance mode.
stopConditions: No usable credential reference or RAM role is available.
The identity, region, private-access posture, retention mode, or 30-day duration cannot be verified before upload.
Any independently billable action could exceed CNY 100.
The candidate input is not demonstrably synthetic.
The requested policy would permit retention bypass or require production-data access.
